evidence.field: 网 形義通解; graphic analysis and attested uses
evidence.text: The database analyzes oracle-bone and bronze forms as a spread net with crossing mesh lines and calls 网 the early graph for 網. It reports oracle-bone verb uses for catching game, including 合集 10514「网雉，隻（獲）八」and 合集 28329「网鹿」, and says bronze forms also occur in personal or clan names. It describes later forms as joining the top lines into a horizontal stroke, then adding 亡 as a sound element to make 罔 and 糸 as a meaning element to make 網. These examples are not assigned absolute dates on the inspected page.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》 (Taiwan Ministry of Education)
evidence.field: A03137 / 說文釋形, 字樣說明, senses
evidence.text: The entry reports that Shuowen gives 网 as the main seal form and lists forms involving 亡 and 糸. It explicitly analyzes 網 as 糸 plus the phonetic 罔. It records physical net, catching with a net, net-like things, network systems, seeking people, and figurative constraint, with textual examples including the Book of Odes and Shiji. The entry supplies examples, not a dated first-occurrence sequence or a complete semantic pathway.
evidence.kind: official lexicographic analysis and cited examples
evidence.title: [A03137] 網 — 教育部《異體字字典》

search_audit.outcome: Opened the CUHK character pages. The 網 and 网 pages support the pictographic analysis, reported oracle-bone net-catching uses, and the source's component account. The 罔 page was opened but did not expose readable lines in the returned result.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Taiwan Ministry of Education 網 entry and the related 网 entry. The 網 page explicitly describes 糸 as semantic and 罔 as phonetic, quotes Shuowen forms, and gives sense examples without establishing semantic chronology.

gaps: The official Unicode individual records for 网, 網, and 罔 were inaccessible. Local kMandarin and Baxter–Sagart rows were checked as supplied, but no character-specific Unihan page was verified.

The local rows checked were sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt (kMandarin) and sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv (Baxter–Sagart 2014); they are not external sources. The exact Mandarin values are wǎng for all three graphs; the Baxter–Sagart notation is MC mjangX and OC *maŋʔ (or *C.maŋʔ ?) for all three. Do not merge it with Zhengzhang reconstructions in other sources.

The sources support a proposed 罔 phonetic role in 網 and give the same modern Mandarin and local Baxter–Sagart rows for both, but no independent primary historical-phonology source was inspected here. Similar readings do not alone establish the graphic history.
The source-reported oracle-bone examples are not absolutely dated on the inspected page. Do not assign them precise dates from the page alone.

The evidence distinguishes the physical-net graph and its oracle-bone verb use from later senses. It does not establish the earliest net noun occurrence, a dated link to the legal metaphor, or the first modern network sense. Gloss order is not chronology.
No reuse terms for a bulk extract from the recurring dictionaries were verified; character-specific citations and paraphrases suffice, so no local extract is recommended.

The candidate images are modern redrawings of script forms, not artifact photographs. The oracle SVG URL was verified as the exact Commons original-image link but could not be fetched by the web tool.
